instruction: Use web resources to learn how to set up automatic syntax highlighting in Vim and configure my Vim as needed.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

include: The File Has Set Syntax On!

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching online for how to enable syntax highlighting in Vim (syntax on) and configuring .vimrc file. The evaluator checks if 'syntax on' is present in ~/.vimrc. This is a similar complexity task to the original, requiring the same steps: search online, understand the command, and edit the .vimrc file.
